hits.name: Errands
hits.description:
Todo application for those who prefer simplicity.
      Features:
      
        Add, remove, edit tasks, sub-tasks, and task lists
        Add accent color, time, tags, attachments and notes for each task
        Recurrent tasks
        Drag and Drop support
        Import / Export .ics files
        Sync tasks with Nextcloud or other CalDAV providers

hits.name: word-sys PDF Editor
hits.summary: Edit text content in PDF files
hits.description:
An open-source tool for editing content in PDF files on Linux. Edit text and images directly
      on the page, merge and reorder pages, draw shapes and highlights, and export to PDF or plain text.

hits.name: Video Player
hits.description:
Play your favorite movies and video files without hassle. Video Player features simple playback
      controls that fade out of your way when you're watching, fullscreen, adjustable playback speed,
      multiple language and subtitle tracks, and screenshots — everything you need for a straightforward
      viewing experience.

hits.name: EdiTidE
hits.description:
Source-code editor, with basic project support. It can be enhanced with extensions.
      Main features:
      
        Syntax highlighting
        Dark/light themes
        Project browser
        Search in file or project, with regex support
        Symbols of active source file
        Extendable command bar
        Block/column edition mode

hits.name: Antimatter
hits.summary: A lightweight Python and Markdown code editor
hits.description:
Antimatter is a Python and Markdown IDE designed to run smoothly on your computer without suffering
      from the bloat other IDEs tend to have. This edition of the editor focuses only on editing files
      and help you debug them. The editor features the following functions:
      
        A Distraction-free interface.
        Ability to comfortably edit Python and Markdown documents.
        Full Discord Rich Presence Support.
        Lightweight and responsive UI.
        A sleek, PyQT6 Interface built from the ground up to beautifully integrate with the KDE Plasma
        desktop environment.
        Quickly find the bugs that stop you from running your Python scripts using Ruff.

hits.name: Apx GUI
hits.description:
Apx GUI provides a user-friendly interface for Apx, a platform powered by Distrobox that streamlines
      dev environments into portable, reproducible subsystems. Originally created for Vanilla OS, it
      can also be installed on any Linux distribution.

hits.name: Ant Renamer Qt
hits.description:
Ant Renamer Qt renames many files and folders in one go: replace, insert, move or delete text,
      enumerate, change case, regular expressions, names taken from a list, and tags read from MP3 files
      (ID3) and from images (EXIF, IPTC, XMP).
      It is the C++/Qt 6 port of Ant Renamer by Antoine Potten, developed alongside the original program,
      with its language files and help.

hits.name: neovide
hits.description:
Fully-featured Neovim GUI with some visual upgrades:
      
        Animated cursor
        Smooth scrolling
        Animated windows
        Blurred floating windows
        Emoji support

hits.name: Tenacity
hits.description:
Tenacity is a free, easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows, Mac OS X,
      GNU/Linux and other operating systems. The interface is translated into many languages.
      You can use Tenacity to:
      
        Record live audio
        Convert tapes and records into digital recordings or CDs
        Edit WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP2, MP3 or Ogg Vorbis sound files
        Cut, copy, splice or mix sounds together
        Change the speed or pitch of a recording
        Apply a wide range of other effects to audio recordings

hits.name: Haven
hits.description:
Haven is a Matrix-native chat and social client, built on Element Web/Desktop, combining secure
      end-to-end encrypted messaging with a federated social timeline.

hits.name: Bengal Download Manager
hits.description:
A friendly download helper for your Linux computer. It speeds up large files, catches links
      straight from your browser, and keeps everything neatly sorted in one place.
      
        Speeds up big downloads by grabbing several parts at once
        Saves files from your browser with a single click
        Downloads video and music from popular websites
        Grabs whole websites at once and can run on a schedule
        Lets you cap speeds and files sort themselves into folders

hits.name: Betterbird
hits.description:
Betterbird is a fine-tuned version of Mozilla Thunderbird, Thunderbird on steroids, if you will.
      Betterbird is better than Thunderbird in three ways: It contains new features exclusive to Betterbird,
      it contains bug fixes exclusive to Betterbird and it contains fixes that Thunderbird may ship at
      a later stage.

hits.name: Coot
hits.description:
Coot is a powerful macromolecular model-building tool for analysing X-ray data and models (i.e.
      proteins, ligands, RNA and DNA). There are many tools for model manipulation and building, such
      as minimization, molecular superposition, fragment rotation/translations, rotamer-fitting, de novo
      building and refinement.
      Coot is used by scientists using X-ray crystallography or cryo-EM for analysis of proteins,
      electron density maps, protein interactions and drug design.

hits.name: Rufin
hits.description:
Enjoy your music library, local/remote folders or music server; with a powerful music player.
      
        Supports Jellyfin, Navidrome/OpenSubsonic, Plex and Emby servers, local folders, WebDAV/Nextcloud
        and Samba shares
        Rufin Connect syncs your devices, continues playback from another device and streams its
        local library
        Gapless playback or crossfade, and loudness normalization
        Graphic and parametric equalizer with presets, multichannel output and Dolby/DTS passthrough
        Next track recommendations with Auto DJ, Mix with filters and sleep timer
        Downloads with automatic rules and transcoding
        Playlists across sources, and smart playlists built on metadata and listening activity
        Synced lyrics with karaoke mode, Japanese readings, search/edit/automatically save lyrics
        Metadata and artwork editor with bulk edits, audio fingerprint calculation & lookup
        Last.fm, Libre.fm, ListenBrainz and Discord Rich Presence integrations
        Casting to UPnP and Chromecast, a Web UI and an HTTP API for scripts
        Custom themes, a mini player, fullscreen visualizer and an extensive keyboard shortcuts catalog
        Broad codec support including separable CUE tracks

hits.name: Meron
hits.summary: Fast/secure mail client with kanban and chat views
hits.description:
Unified Inbox, kanban and chat views
        Tags synced as IMAP keywords and mail rules for automatic organization
        IMAP/SMTP email and RSS/Atom feeds
        Threaded conversations with rich-text composing and media galleries
        Built-in calendar, tasks, and contacts
        Easy setup with OAuth or automatic mailbox discovery
        End-to-end OpenPGP encryption with Autocrypt, WKD, and keyserver lookup
        Encrypted local storage with credentials kept in the OS keyring
        Optional local MCP server for AI clients with per-client account permissions
        Themes and 20+ languages

hits.name: Switchfin
hits.description:
Switchfin is third-party PC player for Jellyfin that designed specifically for controller users
      to browse and play movies and series.
      Features:
      
        Completely native interface
        Supported media items: movies, series, seasons, episodes
        Base on MPV Player
        Filter: Quickly find the movie and bangumi
        Search: TV style, Videos and Movie...

hits.name: Longbridge Pro
hits.description:
A new professional securities trading desktop application, delivering an ultra-smooth investment
      experience for more efficient and convenient trading.

hits.name: Mages
hits.description:
Mages is an experimental Matrix chat client built with Compose Multiplatform and a Rust core
      powered by matrix-rust-sdk. The flatpak currently shows 2 tray icons and the tray menu doesn't
      follow the system theme (legacy lib).
      Features include:
      
        Room list with previews and unread counts
        Room and thread timelines (text, media, polls)
        End-to-end encryption via matrix-sdk
        Spaces browser
        Presence and privacy settings
      
      Note: This is experimental software. Things may break, but encryption is handled by the battle-tested
      matrix-rust-sdk.

hits.name: Fluxer
hits.summary: A chat app that puts you first
hits.description:
Fluxer is a free and open-source instant messaging and voice-over-IP application. It provides
      text chat, voice calls, video calls, and screen sharing in a modern interface.
      Features include:
      
        Text messaging with rich formatting and media support
        Voice and video calls
        Screen sharing
        Communities with channels
        Direct messages and group chats
        Custom emoji and reactions

hits.name: AB Download Manager
hits.summary: A Download Manager that speeds up your downloads
hits.description:
AB Download Manager is a desktop application that helps you manage and organize your downloads
      more efficiently than ever before.
      Key Features:
      
        ⚡️ Faster Download Speed
        ⏰ Queues and Schedulers
        🌐 Browser Extensions
        💻 Multiplatform (Windows / Linux / Mac)
        🌙 Multiple Themes (Dark/Light) with modern UI
        ❤️ Free and Open Source
        ⏸️ Pause, resume, and retry downloads
        📊 Download progress and statistics

hits.name: Table Habit
hits.description:
"Table Habit" is an app that helps you establish and track your own micro habit. It includes
      a complete set of growth curves and charts to help you build habits more effectively, and keeps
      your data in sync across devices (currently via WebDAV, with more options coming soon).
      Moreover, this app is completely open source and comes with these features:
      
        A scoring system to help develop your own micro habits.
        Support both positive and negative habit.
        An easy-to-use interface for habit check in.
        A quick search and filter to help quickly find past habits.
        Different colors used to distinguish between various habits.
        Easily export and import habits using a human-readable format (JSON).
        Adapt to Material3 and Dynamic Color for Android 12 and later versions.
        Adaptation for landscape and large screen devices.
        Support network sync with WebDAV.
        No ADs in this app.

hits.name: Sequeler
hits.description:
Easily connect to your local or remote database
      Store your Database Connections in the library, connect over SSH tunnel, type and execute SQL
      commands directly in the app, and do everything you need to do without the necessity of opening
      the terminal.
      Supported Databases:
      
        SQLite
        MySQL
        MariaDB
        PostgreSQL
      
      Features Include:
      
        Test Connections before saving them
        View Table structure, content, and relations
        Write multiple custom SQL Queries
        Switch between light and dark mode
        Handy keyboard shortcuts to quit (ctrl+q), create new connection (ctrl+shift+n), open a new
        window (ctrl+n)

hits.name: Tipitaka Pali Reader
hits.description:
Tipitaka Pali Reader (TPR) is designed for reading and studying Pāḷi texts. It offers integrated
      dictionary support, multi-language definitions, and support for various scripts. Ideal for students
      of early Buddhist texts, it enables fast lookup of word meanings and root structures.
      
        The whole Tipitaka with commentaries and sub-commentaries, in many scripts
        Translations in many languages from ePitaka, shown beneath the Pāḷi
        Tap a word to see its meaning, grammar and root in several dictionaries
        Search the Pāḷi and the translations, in the script you read them in
        Page numbers of the Myanmar, VRI, PTS and Thai editions
        Bookmarks in folders, with cloud transfer between devices
      
      May all beings benefit from this dhamma donation!

hits.name: memento
hits.summary: An mpv-based video player for studying Japanese
hits.description:
Memento is a free and open source, mpv-based video player that makes studying Japanese easier
      with a built in popup dictionary, Anki integration, and more.
      Features:
      
        Memento uses Yomitan's dictionary format and supports all the same dictionaries
        Automates Anki card creation through AnkiConnect
        Grammar aware search matches terms in subtitles regardless of most inflections
        Supports mpv plugins, upscalers, and shaders
        Supports mpv configuration files such as input.conf for rebinding keys and mpv.conf for configuring
        mpv
        Supports streaming from many websites through youtube-dl

hits.name: OBS Studio
hits.description:
Free and open source software for video capturing, recording, and live streaming.
      Features:
      
        High performance real time video/audio capturing and mixing. Create scenes made up of multiple sources including window captures, images, text, browser windows, webcams, capture cards and more.
        Set up an unlimited number of scenes you can switch between seamlessly via custom transitions.
        Intuitive audio mixer with per-source filters such as noise gate, noise suppression, and gain. Take full control with VST plugin support.
        Powerful and easy to use configuration options. Add new Sources, duplicate existing ones, and adjust their properties effortlessly.
        Streamlined Settings panel gives you access to a wide array of configuration options to tweak every aspect of your broadcast or recording.
        Modular 'Dock' UI allows you to rearrange the layout exactly as you like. You can even pop out each individual Dock to its own window.
      
      Create Professional Productions:
      
        Choose from a number of different and customizable transitions for when you switch between your scenes or add your own stinger video files.
        Set hotkeys for nearly every sort of action, such as switching between scenes, starting/stopping streams or recordings, muting audio sources, push to talk, and more.
        Studio Mode lets you preview your scenes and sources before pushing them live. Adjust your scenes and sources or create new ones and ensure they're perfect before your viewers ever see them.
        Get a high level view of your production using the Multiview. Monitor 8 different scenes and easily cue or transition to any of them with merely a single or double click.

hits.name: Chaski
hits.summary: A calmer way to read the web
hits.description:
Chaski is a privacy-focused RSS and Atom feed reader with a modern interface, offline capabilities,
      feed organization, and full-text search.
      It supports OPML import/export and multiple account backends compatible with Google Reader APIs
      such as FreshRSS, Miniflux, and Tiny Tiny RSS.

hits.name: FerrumPix
hits.summary: Photo-Editor, Viewer, Gallery, Immich and Nextcloud Client
hits.description:
FerrumPix brings your photos together in one desktop application. Browse and organise your pictures
      in a gallery, view them quickly, or open them in the editor to make anything from a small correction
      to a more detailed edit. FerrumPix supports RAW photos as well as common image formats, so you
      can work with your pictures in the way that suits you.
      Adjust exposure and colors, develop RAW images, fine-tune tones with curves and color grading,
      or use automatic enhancements. For more creative work, FerrumPix offers layers, masks, filters,
      text and shapes, along with optional AI-assisted selections. Edits can be saved in a project format
      and continued later without losing the original image.
      You can also create new images from scratch, manage your photo collection and connect to your
      own Immich or Nextcloud server. Whether you simply want to look through your photos or spend more
      time editing them, FerrumPix gives you the tools in one place.

hits.name: Holy Bible
hits.summary: An app designed for reading and listening to the Holy Bible
hits.description:
The Application is multi languages, free, offline, no advertising; the graphical interface is
      available in English and other languages.
      Designed for reading, studying, and meditation, it includes notes, books, and biblical promises
      to help in daily life.
      A list of features
      
        Verse lookup
        Bookmarks and commentaries (download commentaries from other public authors)
        Bible reader and dramatized Bible
        Highlight Verses
        Adjust text size, font and alignment
        Quiz
        Devotionals (on the home page)
      
      Future features for the app
      
        Verse sharing
        Notifications (Daily Bread) (when enabled)
        Reading plans with goals and rewards
        Maps with historical timeline updates (tracking national territories and characters);
        Character timeline

hits.name: Hedgewars
hits.summary: Funny turn-based artillery game, featuring fighting Hedgehogs!
hits.description:
Hedgewars is a turn-based strategy, artillery, action and comedy game, featuring the antics
      of pink hedgehogs with attitude as they battle from the depths of hell to the depths of space.
      As commander, it's your job to assemble your crack team of hedgehog soldiers and bring the war
      to your enemy.
      Game features:
      
        Hilarious and strategic turn based combat for up to 8 players
        Singleplayer mode with two campaigns and many scenarios and challenges
        Both local and network multiplayer, with optional AI opponents
        Battle on an infinite number of randomly generated maps, with over 22 environments
        Attack with one of over 38 devastating weapons!
        Including the piano strike and explosive robotic cake
        Utilise over 16 utilities like the rope or portable portal device to pave your path to victory
        Play the game your way, with many different game modifiers, tweak almost every aspect of
        the match
        Customize your team, with numerous hats, costumes, graves, forts, flags and unique voice
        packs
        Huge battles with up to 64 hedgehogs
        Play both singleplayer and multiplayer minigames
        Plugin your own custom maps, costumes, and other artwork

hits.name: PolyMC
hits.summary: A custom launcher for Minecraft that allows you to easily manage multiple installations of Minecraft at once
hits.description:
PolyMC is a custom launcher for Minecraft that focuses on predictability, long term stability,
      and simplicity.
      Features:
      
        Easily install game modifications, such as Fabric, Forge, and Quilt
        Control your Java settings
        Manage worlds and resource packs from the launcher
        See logs and other details easily
        Kill Minecraft in case of a crash/freeze
        Isolate Minecraft instances to keep everything clean
        Install and update mods directly from the launcher

hits.name: Loomfy
hits.description:
Loomfy records and transcribes meetings locally, using your GPU. Audio never has to leave the
      machine: transcription, speaker separation and search all run on device.
      Features:
      
        Real-time transcription with speaker diarization
        GPU-accelerated on-device processing (Vulkan)
        Captures both your microphone and system audio
        AI summaries, action items and decisions
        Keyword alerts while a meeting is running
        Import audio files (MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC)
        Export to PDF and Markdown
      
      A free account is not required to record and transcribe locally. Cloud features such as AI summaries
      and document generation need an account and a paid plan.

hits.name: Gluon Scene Builder
hits.description:
Integrated: Scene Builder works with the JavaFX ecosystem - official controls, community projects,
      and Gluon offerings including Gluon Mobile, Gluon Desktop, and Gluon CloudLink.
      Simple: Drag 'n' Drop user interface design allows for rapid iteration. Separation of design
      and logic files allows for team members to quickly and easily focus on their specific layer of
      application development.
      Supported: Scene Builder is free and open source, but is backed by Gluon. Commercial support
      offerings are available, including training and custom consultancy services.

hits.name: Stochas
hits.description: Stochas is a probabilistic polyrhythmic sequencer.

hits.name: PKHeX-Avalonia
hits.description:
Open a save from the main series games, from Red and Blue through Legends: Z-A, and change Pokémon,
      boxes, the party, items and trainer details. Each Pokémon gets a legality check, so you can spot
      problems before you save.
      Game-specific editors cover Pokédex progress, events, raids, fashion, mystery gifts and more.
      Changes stay in the app until you save, and the previous file is backed up automatically.
      PKHeX-Avalonia is a fan project built on the PKHeX engine. It is not affiliated with Nintendo,
      Game Freak or The Pokémon Company.

hits.name: Vistava
hits.description:
Vistava turns your media library into a peaceful, minimalist gallery - your very own exhibition.
      
        View your images and videos without distractions
        Move through your library easily - via mouse, keyboard, touch screen, or gamepad
        Stream your media to any web browser on your network - like on a TV, smartphone, or VR headset
        View content from third-party web sources with optional extensions

hits.name: Turbo Clicker
hits.description:
Turbo Clicker is a GUI based auto-clicker for Linux (Wayland). It simulates virtual input via
      x11/wayland-client.
      The user needs to accept remote access permissions for the app.

hits.name: BMI
hits.description: Calculator for body health metrics. Built with GTK4 and LibAdwaita.

hits.name: Xpano
hits.description:
Xpano is a photo stitching tool that focuses on simplicity and ease of use, you can use it to:
      
        Auto detect groups of images that can be stitched into panoramas
        Quickly preview the results with zoom and pan
        Crop, auto fill boundaries and select from multiple projection types
        Adjust the projection parameters: pitch, yaw and roll
        Export full resolution panoramas, including exif metadata

hits.name: Lightning
hits.description:
Lightning is a desktop messenger for Matrix, the open network for secure, decentralised communication.
      Sign in to any homeserver, or to several accounts at once, and reach people wherever their account
      lives.
      Conversations are organised into Spaces, rooms and threads. Send rich text, pictures, files,
      voice messages, polls, reactions and custom emoji, and find something you sent months ago without
      scrolling back to it.
      Private rooms are end-to-end encrypted throughout: verify your other devices by comparing emoji,
      restore your keys from backup, and search even your encrypted rooms with an index that never leaves
      this computer.
      Group voice calls and screen sharing run in the room itself.

hits.name: Tryton 7.0
hits.description:
Tryton is business software, ideal for companies of any size, easy to use, complete and 100%
      Open Source.
